OR
Build an algorithm in flowchart form for adding and subtracting two
fixed point binary numbers when negative numbers are in signed 1’s
complement representation.
Construct a Decimal Arithmetic Unit to perform BCD addition and
BCD Subtraction.

With the help of block diagram of interface between processor and
peripheral devices explain its operations.
Describe the DMA operation with neat diagram.

OR

and ROM chips with the help of function table.
Distinguish between Direct mapping, Set-Associative mapping and
Associate mapping of cache memory.

Illustrate between Array processor and Vector Processor. State the
advantages, disadvantages and applications of vector processors.
Compare and contrast between parallel processing and pipeline
processing with suitable examples.
OR

What is pipelining? Demonstrate the pipeline organization with an
example.
Analyze the concurrent access to memory and cache coherency.
